name: @epoch/device-capabilities
description: Epoch Device Capabilities kernel (W019, experience layer) — the device-side half of Renderer/Device Adaptation (R29 device-aware fidelity): the canonical device-class profile table that FILLS the abstract W011 device-descriptor slot (a host that knows only a device class gets a valid, provider-neutral DeviceDescriptor), deterministic sealed DeviceCapabilityAssessment records deriving the typed adaptation tier (desktop=full, laptop/web=normal, tablet/phone=field, low capability=reduced, remote assist optional) plus axis flags and modality coverage from descriptor data alone, and presentation fit/gap analysis comparing a descriptor against declared presentation requirements (typed budget shortfalls, modality gaps, stereoscopic and tracking mismatches). Pure typed data: zero wall-clock, zero randomness, zero I/O, zero engine/vendor vocabulary; assessments are content-addressed canonical SHA-256 records.
